correctness.rationale: Guo’s exact transformed quotient sum has terms T_(n,j) with v2(T_(n,j))=2j−3+v2(j)+s2(j)+3s2(n−j)−s2(3n−2j). At n=2^r binary complementation yields 2r+2j−2−s2(j−1) for j≤n/2, with the unique minimum 2r at j=1. For j>n/2 the factor 4^j and integral multinomial bound every term strictly above 2r, including explicit r=2 endpoints; no cancellation is possible. Since v2(n binom(2n,n))=r+1, v2(S)=3r+1. Independently computed direct Franel sums n=4,8,16,32,64,128,256 and checked both S and quotient valuations. S2=0 and r=1 are correctly excluded.
residual_risks: Only r≥2 and dyadic indices; no odd-prime generalization.
